messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

output:
**What teams say after the first bad night**

> "We had a checkout bug that only showed up for customers paying in yen. Four services, three languages, and the stack trace was in none of them. I found it in about twenty minutes, because I could put all four streams on one screen and scroll."
> — Priya Raghunathan, Staff Engineer, Kettle & Co.

> "Honestly, I was skeptical. We'd already migrated twice and both times the pitch was better than the product. What sold me was the ingest bill. We push 900 GB a week now and pay less than we did for 300."
> — Marcus Oyelaran, VP Infrastructure, Northbound Freight

> "Our on-call rotation is six people and two of them joined this year. Last month they handled a Redis eviction storm at 2 a.m. without paging me. I read about it in the morning. That's the whole review."
> — Dana Kirsch, Engineering Manager, Vestibule Health

> "The seven-day retention default was wrong for us — we're audited, we need thirteen months. Support had a tiered archive set up in a day and didn't try to sell us a bigger plan first."
> — Tomás Bergqvist, Head of Platform, Ardal Bank

*Read the full case studies →*

(217 words)
